title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

migration_name.title: Migration name
migration_name.description: Which cutover does this runbook govern (e.g. orders-db Postgres 13 to 16)?

new_store.title: New store
new_store.description: Which store is being proven and will receive reads after the gate holds?

old_store.title: Old store
old_store.description: Which store is the system of record until read_from_new_on is flipped?

read_from_new_approver.title: Read cutover approver
read_from_new_approver.description: Which role:handle reviews the gate evidence and approves flipping read_from_new_on?

write_to_old_off_approver.title: Write-off approver
write_to_old_off_approver.description: Which role:handle approves turning off writes to the old store after the retention window and the rehearsed flip-back?
